who_this_is_for.text: Visitors and residents travelling to or within Leiden.

when_you_need_it.text: Visitors and residents travelling to or within Leiden.

numbered_steps.title: Step 1
numbered_steps.body: Use the NS journey planner for trains and Qbuzz Zuid-Holland Noord for regional buses; check disruptions on your travel day.

numbered_steps.title: Step 2
numbered_steps.body: Choose an accepted ticket or payment card. With OVpay, present one card separately at the reader and check the confirmation.

numbered_steps.title: Step 3
numbered_steps.body: Check out with exactly the same card or device used to check in. A physical card and its phone version are different travel media. Check product rules if you need discounts or a subscription.

practical_guide.disclaimer: General practical information; the responsible authority or care provider decides your individual case.

practical_guide.title: Park your bicycle in Leiden

short_summary.text: Find a permitted place and check the local parking limit.

who_this_is_for.text: Residents and visitors arriving by bicycle, particularly at Leiden Centraal.

when_you_need_it.text: Residents and visitors arriving by bicycle, particularly at Leiden Centraal.

numbered_steps.title: Step 1
numbered_steps.body: Use the municipality’s parking map and choose a rack or designated facility. Around Leiden Centraal, bicycles outside racks can be removed.

numbered_steps.title: Step 2
numbered_steps.body: Check access hours and signs. Waagstalling is at Aalmarkt 22 with entrances from Aalmarkt and Breestraat. Paid subscription sections at stations have separate rules.

numbered_steps.title: Step 3
numbered_steps.body: Retrieve your bicycle before the applicable limit. If missing, check the municipality’s “Fiets weg” instructions before assuming theft.

practical_guide.disclaimer: General practical information; the responsible authority or care provider decides your individual case.

sections.title: Costs
sections.body: Public municipal racks and facilities are free; paid guarded subscription sections also exist.

sections.title: Timing
sections.body: At Leiden Centraal the maximum continuous stay is two weeks. Pop-up Saturday facilities have earlier removal times; read the signs.
